description: pkix-revocation/src/.. deviation.rs: DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains requires the stored substring to be pre-lowercased (documented), but DeviationStore::add does NOT validate this invariant. An operator who writes DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains('Agency X'.to_string()) (mixed case) will have a deviation that silently matches nothing — the scope check always returns false. The test at deviation.rs:943 explicitly tests and documents the silent failure. This creates a silent security gap: the operator believes a deviation is in effect but it never fires. DeviationStore::add should either auto-lowercase the substring or return DeviationAddError for a non-lowercased IssuerDnContains scope.
title: IssuerDnContains accepts uppercase substring silently matches nothing
